title: Advertising
tipVi: Hãy liên hệ đến trải nghiệm thực tế trên mạng xã hội và linh hoạt sử dụng các từ đồng nghĩa như 'commercial', 'sponsored post' hay 'marketing campaign' thay vì lặp lại từ 'advertisement'.
part1: Do you often see advertisements when you browse the internet?
Have you ever bought something directly because of an advert?
What kind of advertisements do you find most annoying?

part2.prompt: Describe an impressive advertisement that you remember well
bullets: what the advertisement was for
where and when you saw it
what happened in the advertisement
and explain why you found it so memorable

part3: In what ways has digital advertising transformed consumer behavior in recent years?
Should governments introduce stricter regulations on advertisements aimed at children?

title: Art
tipVi: Đừng ngần ngại thừa nhận nếu bạn không am hiểu nghệ thuật; hãy tập trung mô tả cảm xúc cá nhân và tác động thị giác thay vì cố dùng thuật ngữ chuyên môn quá phức tạp.
part1: Do you enjoy visiting art galleries or exhibitions?
Did you learn how to draw or paint when you were a child?
Do you have any artwork displayed on the walls of your home?

part2.prompt: Describe a piece of art that left a strong impression on you
bullets: what it was and where you saw it
what it looked like
who created it
and explain why it left such a strong impression on you

part3: Why do some people consider traditional art forms more valuable than digital artwork?
Should governments allocate significant public funds to support artists and cultural institutions?

title: Birthdays and Gifts
tipVi: Khi nói về quà tặng và sinh nhật, hãy tập trung vào giá trị tình cảm và sự tinh tế đằng sau món quà thay vì chỉ miêu tả giá trị vật chất để câu trả lời có chiều sâu hơn.
part1: How do you usually celebrate your birthday?
What kind of gifts do you prefer receiving from your close friends?
Do you think it is difficult to choose a suitable present for someone?

part2.prompt: Describe a meaningful birthday gift you received that made a strong impression on you
bullets: what the gift was
who gave it to you and when you received it
how you reacted upon receiving it
and explain why this gift held special meaning for you

part3: In what ways has the way people celebrate birthdays evolved compared to previous generations?
Do you believe commercialization has diminished the genuine sentimental value of giving presents?

title: Celebrities
tipVi: Hãy tránh việc chỉ liệt kê tiểu sử ngày tháng năm sinh của người nổi tiếng mà hãy tập trung phân tích lý do bạn ngưỡng mộ và sức ảnh hưởng xã hội của họ.
part1: Do you follow any famous people on social media?
Who was your favorite celebrity when you were a child?
Would you like to be famous in the future?

part2.prompt: Describe a celebrity you admire who uses their fame to help others
bullets: who this person is
what achievements they are famous for
how they use their influence to make a positive impact
and explain why you admire this particular celebrity.

part3: Do you think celebrities have a moral responsibility to be positive role models for young people?
How has social media changed the relationship between public figures and their fans?

title: Childhood
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp nhuần nhuyễn thì quá khứ đơn với cấu trúc 'used to' hoặc 'would + V' để miêu tả những thói quen đã qua một cách tự nhiên và chính xác.
part1: Did you enjoy your childhood?
What was your favourite game to play when you were younger?
Who was your closest friend during your primary school years?

part2.prompt: Describe a memorable outdoor activity you enjoyed during your childhood
bullets: what activity it was
where you usually did it
who you took part in it with
and explain why this activity left such a deep impression on you

part3: How have children's leisure activities changed compared to several decades ago?
To what extent does a person's childhood environment shape their adult personality?

title: Clothes and Fashion
tipVi: Hãy chú ý mô tả chất liệu, phom dáng và ngữ cảnh sử dụng thay vì chỉ lặp lại các tính từ chung chung như 'beautiful' hay 'nice'.
part1: What kinds of clothes do you usually like to wear?
Do you prefer shopping for clothes online or in physical stores?
Did you have to wear a school uniform when you were younger?

part2.prompt: Describe an item of clothing you wear on special occasions
bullets: what it looks like and where you got it
when and where you wear it
how often you wear it
and explain why you enjoy wearing it

part3: Why do some people spend an excessive amount of money on designer brands?
How has the rise of fast fashion impacted the environment and consumer behavior?

title: Festivals
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp miêu tả bầu không khí náo nhiệt bằng các tính từ giàu hình ảnh cùng với ý nghĩa văn hóa sâu xa thay vì chỉ liệt kê các hoạt động ăn uống hay vui chơi thông thường.
part1: What is your favorite traditional festival in your country?
How do people usually celebrate public holidays where you live?
Do you prefer spending festival times with your family or friends?

part2.prompt: Describe an exciting festival or cultural celebration you experienced.
bullets: what the festival was and where it took place
who you went with or met there
what activities or rituals you participated in
and explain why this celebration was particularly memorable to you

part3: In what ways do commercial promotions alter the traditional essence of cultural festivals?
Why might younger generations feel less connected to ancient customs and folk celebrations?

title: Hobbies
tipVi: Thay vì lặp lại cấu trúc 'In my free time, I like...', hãy dùng các diễn đạt linh hoạt như 'I tend to unwind by...' hoặc 'I am keen on...' kết hợp làm rõ cảm xúc và lợi ích tinh thần.
part1: Do you have any hobbies that you prefer doing alone rather than with others?
Did you spend your leisure time differently when you were a child?
Is there a new hobby or creative pursuit you would like to take up soon?

part2.prompt: Describe a hobby or leisure activity you recently took up
bullets: what the activity is
how you first learned about it
how often you engage in it
and explain why this hobby has become meaningful to you

part3: Why do some people find it difficult to maintain a regular hobby in modern society?
To what extent can hobbies influence an individual's personal or professional growth?

title: Housing
tipVi: Khi nói về nhà ở, hãy tránh chỉ liệt kê đồ đạc tĩnh mà nên tập trung miêu tả không gian sống, cảm giác thoải mái và thói quen sinh hoạt gắn liền với ngôi nhà.
part1: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
What is your favourite room in your home?
Would you like to move to a different home in the future?

part2.prompt: Describe an ideal home you would like to live in
bullets: where this home would be located
what kind of accommodation it would be
what features or amenities it would have
and explain why you would choose to live in this particular place

part3: What are the main differences between living in a city apartment and living in a countryside house?
How might housing designs change over the next few decades due to environmental challenges?

title: Language Learning
tipVi: Khi nói về việc học ngoại ngữ, hãy chia sẻ trải nghiệm thực tế kèm phương pháp cụ thể thay vì chỉ liệt kê các lợi ích chung chung.
part1: How many languages can you speak?
What do you find most challenging about learning a new language?
Do you prefer learning a language independently or in a classroom?

part2.prompt: Describe a foreign language you would like to learn in the future
bullets: what language it is
how you plan to learn it
what difficulties you might encounter
and explain why you want to learn this particular language

part3: Do you think artificial intelligence and translation tools will make language learning obsolete?
Why do children often pick up foreign languages more quickly than adults?

title: Money
tipVi: Thay vì chỉ lặp lại từ 'money', hãy linh hoạt sử dụng các từ vựng cụ thể hơn như 'finances', 'budget', hay 'expenses' và gắn câu trả lời với thói quen chi tiêu thực tế của bản thân.
part1: Do you prefer paying with cash or using digital payment methods?
Did you save money when you were a child?
What kind of things do you usually spend most of your money on?

part2.prompt: Describe a time when you saved up money to buy something special
bullets: what you wanted to buy
how long it took you to save the money
how you managed to save it
and explain why you were pleased with this purchase

part3: Why do some people find it difficult to manage their personal finances effectively?
To what extent should financial literacy be taught as a compulsory subject in schools?

title: Museums
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp miêu tả trải nghiệm giác quan và cảm xúc cá nhân thay vì chỉ liệt kê các hiện vật khô khan để đạt điểm Lexical Resource cao hơn.
part1: Do you often visit museums or art galleries?
What kind of museums do you find most interesting?
Did you go to any museums when you were a child?

part2.prompt: Describe a museum or exhibition that left a strong impression on you
bullets: where this museum or exhibition is located
what kind of exhibits were on display
who you visited it with
and explain why it left such a strong impression on you

part3: Should public museums charge admission fees or be entirely free for citizens?
How might virtual museum tours change the way people appreciate cultural heritage in the future?

title: Nature and Parks
tipVi: Khi nói về thiên nhiên, hãy linh hoạt miêu tả các giác quan (âm thanh, mùi hương, cảnh sắc) và cảm xúc thư giãn cá nhân thay vì chỉ liệt kê đơn điệu tên các loại cây hay địa danh.
part1: Do you often visit parks or botanical gardens?
What do you usually like to do when you are in natural surroundings?
Did you spend much time outdoors when you were a child?

part2.prompt: Describe an impressive natural park or green space you have visited
bullets: where this place is located
what it looks like and what activities you did there
who accompanied you on the trip
and explain why this natural park left such a strong impression on you

part3: Why is it important for cities to incorporate public green spaces into urban planning?
How might modern technology affect younger generations' connection with the natural world?

title: Neighbours
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp việc kể lại trải nghiệm giao tiếp thực tế với các cụm từ chỉ tính gắn kết cộng đồng để câu trả lời vừa gần gũi vừa đạt điểm từ vựng cao.
part1: How well do you know the people who live next door to you?
How often do you interact with your neighbours?
Do you think it is important to have a good relationship with your neighbours?

part2.prompt: Describe a neighbour who has had a positive impact on your local community
bullets: who this person is
how you first met them
what they have done to help the neighbourhood
and explain why you think their actions made such a positive difference

part3: In what ways has urbanisation changed the relationship between neighbours in modern cities?
To what extent should local governments encourage neighbourhood bonding activities?

title: News
tipVi: Hãy tránh chỉ liệt kê các kênh tin tức; thay vào đó, hãy tập trung vào thói quen tiếp nhận thông tin, tính xác thực của tin tức và tác động tâm lý của các bản tin giật gân.
part1: How do you usually get your daily news?
Do you prefer reading international news or domestic news?
Did you follow the news much when you were younger?

part2.prompt: Describe an interesting piece of news you recently read or watched.
bullets: what the news was about
where and when you learned about it
why you found it interesting
and explain how you felt after hearing this news

part3: Why do many people prefer getting news from social media rather than traditional newspapers?
To what extent should governments regulate fake news on digital platforms?

title: Photography
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp từ vựng miêu tả cảm xúc, ánh sáng và bố cục thay vì chỉ lặp đi lặp lại những cụm từ đơn giản như 'take photos' hay 'nice pictures'.
part1: Do you enjoy taking photos in your daily life?
How often do you look back at old photographs?
Do you prefer taking photos with a smartphone or a digital camera?

part2.prompt: Describe a memorable photograph you have taken
bullets: when and where you took it
what or who was in the photo
what equipment or settings you used
and explain why this photograph is particularly meaningful to you

part3: Why do some people prefer to capture moments on camera rather than simply enjoying them in the present?
How has digital photography altered the way society preserves history and memories?

title: Safety and Crime
tipVi: Khi thảo luận về an toàn và tội phạm, hãy cân bằng giữa góc nhìn cá nhân và xã hội, đồng thời sử dụng các thuật ngữ tư pháp và phòng ngừa chính xác thay vì những từ ngữ tiêu cực chung chung.
part1: Do you feel safe walking alone in your neighborhood at night?
What do you usually do to keep your personal belongings safe when traveling?
Have you ever witnessed or reported a minor crime?

part2.prompt: Describe a situation when you felt unsafe or worried about your personal security
bullets: when and where it happened
what caused you to feel unsafe
what actions you took to protect yourself
and explain how you felt after the incident was over

part3: Do you think installing more surveillance cameras in public places effectively deters criminal activities?
How might advancements in digital technology change the types of crimes committed in the future?

title: Science
tipVi: Đừng biến câu trả lời thành bài giảng lý thuyết khô khan; hãy liên hệ kiến thức khoa học với trải nghiệm cá nhân hoặc ứng dụng thực tiễn trong đời sống để tạo cảm giác tự nhiên.
part1: Did you enjoy learning science subjects when you were in school?
What area of science do you find most interesting nowadays?
Do you often watch science documentaries or read science news?

part2.prompt: Describe an interesting scientific experiment or theory you learned about
bullets: what it is about
when and where you first learned about it
how it works or how it is conducted
and explain why you found it particularly fascinating

part3: To what extent should scientific research be funded by the government rather than private corporations?
How can schools encourage more young people, especially girls, to pursue careers in science?

title: Sleep
tipVi: Hãy sử dụng các cụm từ học thuật hoặc tự nhiên về thói quen sinh hoạt (như circadian rhythm, sleep hygiene) thay vì chỉ lặp đi lặp lại 'sleep well' hay 'go to bed'.
part1: How many hours of sleep do you usually get each night?
Do you find it easy or difficult to fall asleep?
Do you ever take naps during the middle of the day?

part2.prompt: Describe an occasion when you had trouble sleeping.
bullets: when and where this happened
what caused you to stay awake
what you did to try to sleep
and explain how you felt the next day.

part3: How has modern technology altered people's sleeping habits in recent years?
Should employers encourage their staff to take short naps during the workday?

title: Social Media
tipVi: Hãy tránh chỉ liệt kê tên ứng dụng như Facebook hay TikTok; thay vào đó, hãy tập trung vào thói quen sử dụng, cảm xúc và tác động của nội dung số lên tâm lý cá nhân.
part1: How often do you use social media platforms?
Which social media app do you spend the most time on?
Do you think people in your country spend too much time on social networking sites?

part2.prompt: Describe an interesting social media account or channel you follow
bullets: what platform it is on and who runs it
what kind of content they share
how often you check or interact with this account
and explain why you find this account interesting or worthwhile to follow

part3: How has social media transformed the way young people communicate with each other?
Do you think social media platforms should be held accountable for misleading information?

title: Teachers
tipVi: Khi nói về thầy cô, hãy tránh lặp lại các tính từ cơ bản như 'good' hay 'kind', thay vào đó hãy miêu tả cụ thể phương pháp giảng dạy và tác động lâu dài của họ đối với tư duy của bạn.
part1: Do you remember your first teacher from primary school?
What qualities do you think make a good teacher?
Would you ever consider becoming a teacher in the future?

part2.prompt: Describe a teacher who had a significant influence on your education
bullets: who this teacher was and what subject they taught
when and where you were taught by them
what made their teaching style special or unique
and explain why this teacher had such a lasting impact on you

part3: How has the role of teachers changed with the rise of modern educational technology?
Should teachers be primarily responsible for teaching academic subjects or moral values to children?

title: Time Management
tipVi: Hãy tránh chỉ liệt kê các hoạt động trong ngày, thay vào đó hãy nhấn mạnh phương pháp bạn chọn ưu tiên công việc và cách bạn duy trì sự cân bằng cuộc sống.
part1: Do you usually plan your day in advance?
What do you find most difficult about managing your time?
Did you learn how to manage your time when you were a child?

part2.prompt: Describe a technique or habit you use to manage your time effectively
bullets: what technique or habit it is
when and how you started using it
how it helps you organise your daily routine
and explain why you think it works well for you

part3: Why do some people struggle to balance their work commitments and personal life nowadays?
To what extent can digital tools improve personal productivity compared to traditional paper planners?

title: Transport
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp linh hoạt từ vựng miêu tả cơ sở hạ tầng và thói quen đi lại cá nhân, tránh chỉ lặp đi lặp lại các danh từ phương tiện cơ bản như motorbike hay bus.
part1: How do you usually commute to work or school?
Have your travel habits changed over the past few years?
Do you think public transport in your hometown is efficient?

part2.prompt: Describe a journey on public transport that was memorable to you
bullets: what form of transport you took
where and when this journey took place
who you travelled with
and explain why this journey was so memorable to you

part3: What measures can city planners take to encourage more citizens to use public transit?
Do you believe that high-speed rail networks will eventually replace domestic flights?

title: Volunteering
tipVi: Hãy chia sẻ một trải nghiệm thực tế cụ thể và làm nổi bật sự tác động tích cực thay vì chỉ nói lý thuyết chung chung về lòng nhân ái.
part1: Have you ever done any voluntary work?
Would you like to volunteer in the future?
What kinds of volunteer activities are popular among young people in your country?

part2.prompt: Describe a voluntary activity you took part in or would like to join
bullets: what the activity was
where and when it took place (or would take place)
who you did it with (or would do it with)
and explain why you decided to join (or want to join) this activity

part3: Should voluntary work be compulsory for high school students before graduation?
How can non-profit organizations encourage more people to participate in community service?
